remainingRows.requiredUseAssessment: Used for HTTP/runtime compression. Direct gz* file-writing paths were not found; transitive consumers not exhaustively audited. CVE-2026-76844 conflicts with current vendor description and is retained.
remainingRows.mechanism: Current vendor description: webpack-dev-middleware path traversal. Scanner package: zlib1g. Attribution mismatch unresolved.
remainingRows.untrustedInputPrerequisites: Failed gzip stream write followed by affected subsequent gz* operation; native reachability uncertain.
remainingRows.status: Unresolved scanner/package identity conflict: current Debian describes webpack-dev-middleware, scanner associates zlib. Prior zlib mechanism is not established for this current CVE; not suppressed.
remainingRows.mitigations: Locally verified UID nonroot, read-only app/rootfs, CapEff=0, CapBnd=0, NoNewPrivs=1. These are not a patch or an independent unreachability finding; hosted enforcement remains unverified.
